units.source_text: 目连俗作目莲，是释迦佛的弟子，

en.t: Mulian, commonly written as Mulian, was a disciple of Shakyamuni Buddha,

units.source_text: 其母死后堕饿鬼道中，食物入口，即化烈火。

en.t: after his mother died, she fell into the realm of hungry ghosts, and whenever food entered her mouth, it immediately turned into raging flames.

units.source_text: 目连求救于佛，佛教在七月十五日作盂兰盆会，以救其母。

en.t: Mulian appealed to the Buddha for help, and the Buddha taught him to hold the Ullambana ceremony on the fifteenth day of the seventh month in order to save his mother.
